import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    used = bytearray(p)
    t = 0
    for i in range(p):
        if not used[i]:
            t += 1
            stack = [i]
            while stack:
                v = stack.pop()
                if used[v]:
                    continue
                used[v] = 1
                to = (v * k) % p
                if not used[to]:
                    stack.append(to)
    ans = 1
    limit = t + (1 if k == 1 else 0)
    MOD = 1000000007
    for _ in range(1, limit):
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
